Task: one PNG image (max 1024x1024, max 1 MiB) that sums up the world's news of Tuesday 24 November 2026. Write with your own hands: (1) draw.py (Python + Pillow, font DejaVuSans available at /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/) that draws entry.png, and (2) main.ts (TypeScript, node:fs) that copies entry.png into $MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR (default /output). Iterate the drawing at least twice (check text widths/overflow, adjust).

The day's biggest stories (verify facts from these summaries; do not invent):
1. IRAN WAR / HORMUZ — Iranian army commander ordered the Strait of Hormuz closed "further day by day" until Washington meets Tehran's seven conditions; IRGC says three oil tankers hit naval mines and caught fire in the strait despite US air escort (JMIC says unconfirmed); US Treasury widened sanctions on Iran's shadow banking networks; Brent crude ~$89. Qatar's PM met Rubio and Vance to push US-Iran talks; Qatar protested Iran summoning its diplomat over a Doha-Berlin joint statement.
2. RUSSIA-UKRAINE — Putin says retaliation for Ukraine's refinery strikes is "inevitable"; Ukrainian drones have cut Russian refining volumes ~45% since late October. Ukraine sank the Russian corvette Merkury with naval drones at Benghazi, Libya, and hit a cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland; Libya and Italy condemned the Libya strikes. Russia accused NATO's Estonia of actions "on the verge of unleashing open war"; Poland summoned the Russian ambassador after missile/drone airspace violations. Two killed, 40 wounded in Zaporizhzhia overnight.
3. TECH / AI — Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO 11 days after his resignation over scandal, after President Trump personally lobbied the board, calling Huang "a national treasure" and saying the country needs his leadership; shares surged. AI stocks tumbled Tuesday, dragging the US market lower; Anthropic stock fell below its $83 IPO price. UN chief called for a global AI-oversight framework within a year.
4. MIDEAST — Houthis advanced ~60 km toward Aden; Yemen's army declared "Aden is a red line". Nine killed in Israeli strikes in Gaza; Hamas interior-security chief killed. Riyadh financial-district tower attacked for the second time in a week, 11 injured.

Design: dark editorial infographic, masthead "WORLD NEWS — 24 November 2026", 4 story cards with colored side bars (war red, diplomacy amber, tech blue, mideast orange) with readable wrapped text (max ~90 chars per line, verify no overflow), footer strip with smaller items. Look at what a professional newspaper graphic looks like: strong hierarchy, generous margins, consistent spacing. Iterate at least twice on layout quality (spacing, alignment, contrast) and make it genuinely good — the judge compares screenshots pairwise on visual quality and accuracy.
Do not touch LICENSE/.makefun. Report final image size and what you improved in each iteration.
